limitation: Prepared numeric oracle targets only; no decoder, activations, model response or new model query. Only current values after each visible assignment are used; hidden outputs, future assignments and output relevance are excluded. Equality/order and additive/subtractive identities are boolean tasks; signed difference is a separate numeric regression target. Constant/all-false boolean cells can be solved by a trivial prior and do not establish a useful decoding task. Each structural group has equal weight after deduplicating current numeric states within that group; numeric/naming relatives are not independent replications. A later direct relation probe must be compared with relations derived from independently decoded values. Relation recovery alone cannot establish a dedicated relational code, causal use, ownership or mechanism C. Numeric oracle values and all relations here are TARGETS, not readout/prediction features.
statistical_unit: Equal-weight structural groups; deduplicated current numeric states within each group/context.
